Action: ## Test Keyboard Navigation and Dropdown Focus Behaviour
Setup: Use a viewport width of at least 1280 pixels so that the full navigation is displayed.
Setup: Complete the navigation checks using only the keyboard. Use Tab to move forwards, Shift+Tab to move backwards, Enter to activate a link or button, and Escape to close an open dropdown.

Setup: To begin navigating from the start of a page, reload it and do not click anywhere in the page. Press Tab. If focus remains in the browser controls, press F6 on Windows or Control+F6 on macOS until focus moves into the webpage, then press Tab. On some keyboards, the Fn key must be held while pressing F6.
Open the DOAJ homepage, place focus at the beginning of the page and use Tab to reach the "Login" link

Expected Test Results: A visible focus indicator identifies each focused link or button
Focus moves through the interactive elements in a logical order
